description: Rejseplanen stoppestedsdata is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rejsekort & Rejseplan A/S. Static list of stops (stops and stations). Coverage: Rejsekort & Rejseplan A/S. The portal shows the English title as "Itinerary stop data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rejsekort & Rejseplan A/S. Its keywords include Transportdata, ITS-direktivet, Tog, busser, Offentlig Transport, Regeringen og den offentlige sektor. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
